===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3566 @1.8GHz :Quad-Core ARM (Cortex-A55) *GPU: ''Mali-G52 2EE'' (OpenGL ES3.2); NPU 0.8TOPS @INT8 :VPU (with 4K VP9 and 4K 10-bit H265/H264 decoding) *Storage: 32GB (eMMC 5.1) Flash *Memory: 4GB (LPDDR4) SDRAM *Wi-Fi: [[Broadcom]] BCM43456 ([[AMPAK AP6256]]) :802.11abgn/ac (1T1R) + BT 5.0 Combo SiP Module *USB: 1x USB 2.0 (Type-C) Host, :1x USB 2.0 (Type-C) (OTG/Power) ports *GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *Power Source: 5V/2A, USB (Type-C)
